evidence.excerpt: FORMIOT investigates the application of formally inferred finite automaton models to the problem of verifying expected behaviour of IoT devices deployed in smart-building and smart-city infrastructure. The project establishes a testbed of 30 representative consumer and industrial IoT devices, collects long-term traffic datasets under normal and fault-injected conditions, and evaluates multiple inference algorithms on their ability to produce accurate and compact behavioural models. A particular focus is on encrypted-traffic scenarios where only metadata is available. Results are intended to inform procurement guidelines for IoT devices in public-sector infrastructure in Vojvodina. The project involves a local engineering company as an industry partner providing device access and domain expertise.
